title: Casting of RE Panels
summary: In-house casting yard with precision steel moulds, M40/M45 concrete, certified rebar, batch QC, and dispatch management.
features: Dedicated casting yard with steel proprietary moulds
M40 / M45 grade concrete per project specification
Rebar cage fabrication, assembly, and placement
Wet curing, visual and dimensional inspection
Batch records and material test documentation
Organised stacking, marking, and site dispatch

title: Erection of RE Panels
summary: Hydra and ACE crane operations for precise panel erection, geogrid placement, fill compaction, and structural sign-off.
features: Escorts Hydra Model 14T and ACE 14XW crane operations
Certified riggers and trained installation crew
Panel plumb and level setting with survey instruments
Geogrid installation at specified spacing intervals
Engineered fill placement and compaction testing
Final alignment, coping, and structural sign-off

title: Level Pad Construction
summary: PCC level pad foundations for RE walls — trench excavation, surveying, laser levelling, and cured finish before panel erection.
features: Trench excavation to design depth and width
PCC level pad casting with correct grade concrete
Elevation set to design drawing specification
Curing and inspection record before erection begins

title: Road Formation & Earthwork
summary: Bulk earthwork, embankment construction, and subgrade preparation for stable road formations ready for pavement layers.
features: Bulk earthwork, cut, and fill operations
Compaction to specified Modified Proctor density

title: Panel Transport & Logistics
summary: Complete logistics chain from casting yard to site — low-bed trailers, route surveys, and on-site sequencing.
features: Low-bed trailer transport for RE panels
Route survey and over-dimensional load permits
On-site panel numbering, stacking, and management
Aggregate, fill, and concrete material haulage

title: Project Management & QA
summary: Rigorous QA/QC procedures and complete documentation across every stage of construction.
features: Dedicated site engineer and supervisors on each project
Daily progress logs and site photography

title: Architectural Design & Planning
summary: Concept design and site planning support, from early concept through to buildable, compliant design.

title: Engineering Consultancy & Technical Testing
summary: Technical testing and analysis, and engineering consultancy for material quality and structural performance confidence.
features: Compliance review against IS codes and standards

title: Highway & Road Project Consultancy
summary: End-to-end technical consultancy for highway and road projects — feasibility, design review, and construction supervision.
features: Design and drawing review against IRC/MoRTH standards

title: NSV Survey
summary: Network Survey Vehicle surveys for high-speed pavement condition assessment across long highway stretches.
features: Data suitable for pavement management systems

title: FWD Test
summary: Falling Weight Deflectometer testing to evaluate structural strength and load-bearing capacity of pavements.
features: Deflection basin measurement at design chainages

title: NDT Test
summary: Non-Destructive Testing of concrete and structural elements to assess strength and integrity without damage.

title: MBIU Supervision
summary: Major Bridge Inspection Unit supervision for detailed inspection and condition assessment of major bridges.
features: Principal and routine bridge inspection supervision

title: Box Culvert
summary: Construction of RCC box culverts for cross-drainage and minor waterway crossings.

title: Vehicular Underpass (VUP)
summary: Execution of Vehicular Underpass structures enabling safe cross-movement of traffic beneath the highway.
features: Approach slab and wing wall construction

title: Light Vehicular Underpass (LVUP)
summary: Construction of Light Vehicular Underpass structures for local and agricultural traffic connectivity.

title: Minor Bridge (MNB)
summary: Execution of Minor Bridge structures across streams and waterways along the highway alignment.

title: Roadside Drain
summary: Construction of roadside drains for effective surface water management along the highway formation.
